preregistration.written_at_note: Upper bound: the commit time of the first preregistration commit (4484138). Written between 06:18:35Z and that commit; corrected in the same unpushed commit before any check ran.
preregistration.expectation: Matched forecast comparison (fcmp) on the same frozen series and the 20 skfolio WalkForward development folds: origins are episode decision sessions t (global stride-5 anchor) inside each test fold with t+5 inside the segment; context is the 252 sessions ending at t; target r = ln(close[t+5]/close[t]) per asset.
criteria: Arms: naive (r_hat=0), statsforecast 2.1.1 AutoARIMA on log close, statsmodels 0.15.0 ARIMA(1,1,1) on log close, chronos-bolt-small (HF amazon/chronos-bolt-small at 772f3d25d38aec6d914c8949dab4462e2d46f5d8, chronos-forecasting 2.3.2, CPU) median at step 5, Kronos-small (gap 7/14).
Preregistered primary metric: per-fold MAE of r_hat vs r across all origins and assets in the fold; secondary: per-fold RMSE and MAE ratio to naive.
Interval: 95% percentile bootstrap over the 20 development folds (10,000 resamples, seed 20260923) of the mean per-fold MAE difference; a model is called better only if the interval excludes zero.
Reserved 2021Q1 fold reported separately and not used for any choice.
Settled for gap 6 if statsforecast and chronos both run on every fold and per-fold metrics are retained.

fix_rounds.trigger: Attempt 1 (single process, all arms, CPU) started 06:22:36Z under ecosystem-bounded-run with a 1200 s limit. The statsforecast, statsmodels and chronos stages finished within about 30 s (Kronos weights were loading by 06:23:05Z), then the Kronos-small CPU stage (sample_count=20, 21 folds) ran until the 1200 s limit stopped the job at about 06:42:36Z; no results.json was written. statsforecast n_jobs=-1 also exhausted the job's 256-task limit (OpenBLAS 'blas_thread_init' and tqdm 'can't start new thread' warnings). Attempt 1 is retained as a stopped attempt, not a result.
fix_rounds.change: Split into two bounded processes with identical origins, context, target and seeds: (A) naive, statsforecast, statsmodels, chronos on CPU with OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 and statsforecast n_jobs=4; (B) Kronos-small with the same parameters (pred_len=5, T=1.0, top_p=0.9, sample_count=20, torch seed 0) on the local CUDA GPU instead of CPU, a deviation from the CPU wording of the original preregistration. A merge step computes the preregistered metrics and bootstrap intervals from both forecast files after checking that the (fold, asset, decision) keys and targets are identical. Each process is again bounded to 20 minutes; a Kronos stop at the limit is recorded as not_settled for the Kronos clauses.

detection_method: The merge step fails if the origin keys or targets of the two forecast files differ; the bootstrap reports a resolved difference whenever the interval excludes zero, as it does for Kronos (receipt 7), so a no-difference result is not a blind spot.
remaining: The comparison now exists and was run as specified, but it shows no resolved difference between the two adopted candidates (c5, c12), so it does not turn the winner set into a performance ranking. Mapping this result into the layer verdict belongs to the ledger owner.
limits: One target (5-session log return), one context length (252), three ETFs, 20 folds; the bootstrap resamples folds, which are serially dependent.
